captions.detailed: This is a 3D model of compact roof-prism binoculars colored in matte black with dark blue glass lenses. It features two symmetrical cylindrical optical barrels connected by a central bridge housing. The model includes an adjustable center focus wheel mounted on a central bridge hinge, and a detailed diopter adjustment ring with silver markings on the right eyepiece barrel.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact roof-prism binocular in CadQuery. The design must feature two symmetrical optical barrels, a central bridge housing, a center focus wheel, and a diopter adjustment ring on the right eyepiece. Incorporate revolute joints for the interpupillary hinge, focus wheel, and diopter ring, and assign appropriate black, silver, and blue-glass materials.
captions.factory: The code constructs the binoculars by defining several parts: a central bridge housing, left and right optical barrels, a center focus wheel, and a diopter ring. Cylinders and boxes are used as base geometries, positioned using offsets and rotations. A central interpupillary hinge is established as a revolute joint connecting the bridge and the barrels, while additional revolute joints are declared for the focus wheel and the diopter ring relative to their parent components.
